content.short: Stablecoin business account for storing and moving money.
content.description: Dakota, founded by alumni of Coinbase, Square, and Airbnb, is a stablecoin-native business banking platform that lets companies store and move money in US dollars or stablecoins while still connecting to traditional rails like ACH, SWIFT, and SEPA. Its business account offers stablecoin custody, cross-border treasury, international payouts, and compliance tooling, using USDC across networks such as Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon as the underlying settlement layer. Backed by a Series A led by CoinFund, Dakota targets businesses and fintechs that want the speed and global reach of stablecoins with the familiarity of a bank account. By blending on-chain settlement with conventional payment networks, it positions itself as a modern account without a traditional bank behind it.
